title: Stilt Fishing
tagline: Balance on the stilt. Land the fish.
description: Sit on a crossbar in the surf off Sri Lanka's southern coast and fish from dawn to dusk. Keep your seat as the swells roll in, tap the water to cast at the fish you can see, set the hook when the float dives and play each fish in with a reel you must feather. Every catch is weighed, logged and released.
howToPlay: Hold the pad and slide left or right to lean and keep your seat.
Watch the swells arrive and lean into them before they hit.
Tap the water where a fish swims to cast between swells.
Press the pad the moment the float dives to set the hook.
Reel while the fish rests, let go when it runs and keep the needle in green.
